dossier.summary: Brightwave sells churn forecasting to B2B SaaS finance and customer success teams. It reads billing and product usage data and flags accounts likely to downgrade 60 days ahead. Customers named on the site include Ledgerline and Fieldhouse.
dossier.why_now: Launched a Stripe Billing integration last month and is hiring two account executives.

data.offer: Kenso can run this whole plan for you: research, segments, copy, sending and follow-ups, done for you from $597 a month. Same motion you see here, we just operate it.

strategy.intro: Brightwave wins when a finance leader sees next quarter's churn before the board does. So the campaign goes after the people who own the revenue forecast at SaaS companies that bill through Stripe, and leads with the 60-day warning instead of the dashboard.
strategy.audience: CFOs, VPs of Finance and heads of revenue operations at B2B SaaS companies with 50 to 500 people. We skip companies on annual contracts only, since their churn shows up once a year and the warning matters less.
strategy.offer: A free churn read on their own Stripe data: connect read-only billing, get the 20 accounts most likely to downgrade in the next 60 days. It costs them ten minutes and shows the product working on numbers they already trust.
strategy.channels: Email first, because finance leaders still read it and the offer needs a sentence of context. LinkedIn follows a day later with a short connect note, and a message once they accept.
strategy.goal: Twelve to fifteen conversations with finance leaders in the first two weeks, and at least five churn reads connected. Those reads are the pipeline.

data.segment_notes: Finance leaders at Stripe-billed SaaS go first because the free churn read works on day one for them. RevOps and CS come next once we know which pain gets replies.
data.funnel_notes: The churn read is the lever. If more than a third of positive replies connect Stripe, meetings roughly double.
data.sampling_criteria: Finance leaders at US and UK SaaS companies with 50 to 500 people that bill through Stripe and sell subscriptions to other businesses.
